parameters.query:
-- Paper v4.3: a timeout never pays the seller.
-- (a) review stuck 12h -> rerun_review, (b) deadline passed with no delivery -> refund_expired,
-- (c) dispute re-check stands after 24h without escalation, or DAO silent 72h -> finalize_default
SELECT 'rerun_review' AS method, j.id AS job_id, coalesce(j.onchain_id::text, j.ref) AS chain_job_id,
       j.buyer_id, NULL::numeric AS amount
FROM milestones m JOIN jobs j ON j.id = m.job_id
WHERE m.status IN ('delivered', 'in_review')
  AND coalesce(m.review_deadline,
        (SELECT max(d.created_at) FROM deliveries d WHERE d.milestone_id = m.id) + interval '12 hours') < now()
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM disputes d WHERE d.milestone_id = m.id AND d.status <> 'resolved')
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM chain_txs c WHERE c.job_id = j.id AND c.method = 'rerun_review'
                   AND c.status <> 'rejected' AND c.created_at > now() - interval '12 hours')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'refund_expired', j.id, coalesce(j.onchain_id::text, j.ref), j.buyer_id, m.amount
FROM milestones m JOIN jobs j ON j.id = m.job_id LEFT JOIN bids b ON b.id = j.accepted_bid_id
WHERE m.status = 'funded' AND m.funded_at IS NOT NULL
  AND m.funded_at + make_interval(days => coalesce(b.delivery_days, 14) + 3) < now()
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM deliveries d WHERE d.milestone_id = m.id)
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM chain_txs c WHERE c.job_id = j.id AND c.method = 'refund_expired'
                   AND c.status <> 'rejected')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'finalize_default', j.id, coalesce(j.onchain_id::text, j.ref), j.buyer_id, NULL::numeric
FROM disputes d JOIN milestones m ON m.id = d.milestone_id JOIN jobs j ON j.id = m.job_id
WHERE ((d.status = 'recheck' AND d.escalated_at IS NULL AND d.recheck_at < now() - interval '24 hours')
    OR (d.status = 'escalated' AND d.escalated_at < now() - interval '72 hours'))
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM chain_txs c WHERE c.job_id = j.id AND c.method = 'finalize_default'
                   AND c.status <> 'rejected' AND c.created_at > now() - interval '1 hour');

SELECT j.id AS job_id, j.buyer_id
FROM jobs j
WHERE j.status = 'open' AND j.accepted_bid_id IS NULL
  AND j.posted_at <= now() - make_interval(mins => $1::int)
  AND j.posted_at >  now() - make_interval(mins => $1::int) - interval '1 minute'
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bids b WHERE b.job_id = j.id AND b.status IN ('live', 'shortlisted'));
